text:
Cheng: Heads-up — found a UI exposure in Console after the role-matrix refactor. Viewer account showed an Edit button on Project Settings (could click it, got a 403 backend but UI still reveals the affordance). :eyes:
Maria: yikes. can you paste repro steps + user id?
Cheng: repro: login as viewer U-pt-viewer, go to /projects/42/settings — Edit button visible next to billing contact. Click => modal opens, save => 403. user metadata: role=viewer, inherited_roles=[org-viewer].
Alex: frontend here. yesterday's PR changed permission gating to use the new flattened permissions response from /api/v1/roles/list. UI used to filter out inherited perms via meta.inherited flag. backend refactor removed that flag to reduce payload. UI logic wasn't updated, so it treats missing tag as "permitted" in some code paths. my bad.
Riley: that matches the backend commit I deployed (role-matrix flattening). We returned a compact array like ["projects.read","projects.edit"] with no provenance. Previously it was [{"perm":"projects.edit","inherited":true}].
Maria: security concern: even if action 403s, exposing the button leaks capability surface. classify severity?
Javier: audit logs show click events but key metadata missing for a related KMS export attempt earlier. snippet from logs:
```
audit:event user=U-pt-viewer action=ui.click path=/projects/42/button=edit result=ok? key_id=-
```
key_id is `-` for the earlier export attempt, probably a logging regression from the KMS wrapper after the same refactor.
Sam: product note — customers asked for tighter affordance gating. we should patch UI asap. P2? P1?
Maria: mark P2 for now (exposure without data exfil). escalate if we see further KMS missing fields or successful writes. steps: 1) hotfix UI to rely on server-side capability endpoint (server boolean), 2) add feature flag to rollback, 3) patch audit to include key_id, 4) run query for other exposed affordances.
Alex: I'll open a quick PR to change UI gating to call /api/v1/permissions/check?resource=project:42 which returns {"can_edit":false} instead of relying on raw perm list. will add a feature flag: "rbac_ui_safe_mode".
Riley: Backend can add `provenance` back as a stopgap (small change) — or we push server-side `can_*` endpoints. I can ship `provenance` within 30m as a toggle. which do you prefer?
Maria: short-term: provenance on role list (toggle) so UI can make a deterministic decision immediately. mid-term: server-side capability endpoints. Javier & infra: any issues adding key_id to audit?
Javier: found the KMS wrapper change in the same release that flattened roles — it now calls kmsClient.exportKey() but we swallowed the returned key metadata when we refactored AuditEvent builder. I'll add key_id back to AuditEvent and ship a small migration to backfill where possible.
security-bot: alert: RBAC-UI-EXPOSURE triggered for project 42 (matched pattern of previous regressions). Logged at 2026-03-20T14:02:00Z.
Cheng: timeline note — user reported at 13:55 UTC, I confirmed at 13:58. good catch, team.
Sam: communications: internal incident note to go to #incidents with the current mitigation. external? not yet.
Maria: owner list: Alex (ui hotfix + feature flag), Riley (provenance toggle), Javier (audit + KMS key_id), Cheng (repro + verification), Sam (commms). target: restore UI gating within 1 hour, audit patch within 3.
Alex: PR opened: frontend/#742 — feature flag enabled off by default. testing now.
Riley: PR for provenance toggle ready, will deploy to canary in 15m.
Javier: audit fix patch ready, will deploy after canary verification. backfill plan: best-effort for last 24h.
Maria: when patches live, Cheng please run the original repro and paste updated logs. also run a quick query for other places using `meta.inherited` assumption.
Cheng: will run verification and post results. thanks all. :thumbsup:
